title.zh-CN: 下肢水肿伴活动后胸闷 · 48岁男性
title.en: Leg swelling and exertional chest discomfort · 48-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 既往心脏手术后出现反复水肿，需核对既往术式与新的结构资料。
summary.en: Recurrent oedema after previous cardiac surgery requires comparison of the old operation and current structural findings.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别生物瓣梗阻与症状的一致性。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise concordance between prosthetic obstruction and symptoms.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明正常范围附近的左室射血分数不能排除右心瓣膜病。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why near-normal left ventricular EF does not exclude right-sided valve disease.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出个体化再干预风险评估。
learningOutcomes.en: Propose individualised assessment of reintervention risk.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分单例可行性与长期比较疗效。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish single-case feasibility from comparative long-term efficacy.

text.zh-CN: 22 年前因严重三尖瓣病变接受生物瓣置换。
text.en: Bioprosthetic tricuspid replacement for severe valve disease 22 years earlier.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 改善心功能后症状反复，原团队认为具备再次置换指征；具体瓣口压差和右室功能数值未提供。
text.en: Symptoms persisted after heart-failure treatment and the original team judged reintervention indicated; valve gradients and numerical right ventricular function are not supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 原团队采用胸腔镜辅助再次置换，体外循环 182 分钟；术后第 2 天拔管，第 3 天转普通病房，第 13 天出院。长期随访未提供。
text.en: Thoracoscopic redo replacement used 182 minutes of bypass; extubation occurred on postoperative day 2, ward transfer on day 3 and discharge on day 13. Long-term follow-up is absent.

text.zh-CN: 症状性三尖瓣生物瓣功能障碍
text.en: Symptomatic tricuspid bioprosthetic dysfunction

feedback.zh-CN: 超声重度梗阻与既往瓣膜及症状一致。
feedback.en: Severe obstruction fits the prosthesis history and symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭乙肝解释全部水肿
text.en: Attribute all oedema to hepatitis B

feedback.zh-CN: 肝病可能相关，但不能忽略已记录的瓣膜梗阻。
feedback.en: Liver disease may contribute but does not negate documented valve obstruction.

text.zh-CN: 射血分数 54% 可排除心源性症状
text.en: An EF of 54% excludes a cardiac cause

feedback.zh-CN: 左室射血分数不能排除三尖瓣病变及右心淤血。
feedback.en: Left ventricular EF does not exclude tricuspid disease or right-sided congestion.

prompt.zh-CN: 下一步怎样制定治疗方案？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 心脏团队核对瓣膜机制与手术风险后个体化再干预
text.en: A heart team reviews mechanism and procedural risk before individualised reintervention

feedback.zh-CN: 现行瓣膜指南强调复杂病变的团队评估。
feedback.en: Current valve guidance emphasises team assessment of complex disease.

text.zh-CN: 直接照搬低温室颤术式给所有类似患者
text.en: Apply the reported hypothermic fibrillation technique to all similar patients

feedback.zh-CN: 单例成功不能建立通用术式。
feedback.en: One successful case does not establish a universal technique.

text.zh-CN: 只因既往手术而永久排除再次干预
text.en: Permanently exclude reintervention because surgery was performed before

feedback.zh-CN: 既往手术增加风险，但不是自动排除依据。
feedback.en: Previous surgery adds risk but is not an automatic exclusion.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何理解原报告术式的证据？

text.zh-CN: 出院即证明终生安全
text.en: Discharge proves lifelong safety

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 旧三尖瓣生物瓣重度梗阻，原团队再次置换后短期恢复。
conclusion.en: Severe obstruction of an old tricuspid bioprosthesis was followed by short-term recovery after redo replacement.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 射血分数不能代替瓣膜与右心评估。
keyReasoning.en: Ejection fraction does not replace valve and right-heart assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 复杂再干预需心脏团队评估（ESC/EACTS 2025）。
短期康复与长期安全性分开。
keyReasoning.en: Separate short-term recovery from long-term safety.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
